source.title: Hunger neurons drive feeding through a sustained, positive reinforcement signal.

confidence_rationale: This is the single most direct biological anchor for MECH-306's central paradox. Chen et al. show that AgRP hunger neurons are inhibited within seconds of food detection (the 'instantaneous drive collapses at contact' problem) yet drive feeding because a brief pre-meal burst produces sustained appetitive and consummatory behaviour persisting for tens of minutes WITHOUT continued neuron activity, mediated by a long-lasting potentiation of food's rewarding value. That is precisely the sustained-drive-trace mechanism MECH-306 posits. Gold-standard optogenetics + behaviour, top venue; small discount for the mouse->REE-scalar transfer and for the fact that the persistence here is a reward-potentiation memory rather than a literally floored drive variable.
failure_signatures: The persistence mechanism is a long-lasting potentiation of FOOD REWARD VALUE triggered by a transient drive burst, not a continuously elevated drive_level signal -- so MECH-306's 'floor or slow-trace the drive' framing is one of at least two viable implementations; the biology realises the trace on the benefit/reward side, not necessarily on the drive variable itself.

AgRP inhibition at food contact is near-complete and rapid; if REE's drive_level mirrors AgRP activity faithfully, then any seeding that depends on drive being HIGH at the moment of contact will fail unless the trace is explicitly engineered -- the paper confirms the failure mode EXQ-536a observed (threshold never crossed under instantaneous drive).

mapping.source_claim_statement: AgRP hunger neurons are inhibited within seconds by the sensory detection of food, yet a brief burst of AgRP activity BEFORE food is available promotes intense appetitive and consummatory behaviour that persists for tens of minutes in the absence of continued activation; this is mediated by a long-lasting potentiation of the rewarding properties of food, and AgRP activity is itself positively reinforcing.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-306 claims z_goal seeding cannot rely on instantaneous homeostatic drive because, when well-fed, drive_level collapses at consumption and anti-correlates with benefit_exposure, so effective_benefit (drive x benefit_exposure) never crosses the seeding threshold. Chen et al. supply the biological proof of exactly this collapse-at-contact dynamic AND its resolution: the hunger signal must be carried forward in time (as a sustained behavioural/reward-potentiation state) rather than read instantaneously. This grounds the 'flooring or slow-tracing the drive' design choice for the SD-012 drive-multiplier site.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The biological persistence lives in a potentiation of food's reward value, not in a sustained drive scalar. REE's choice to slow-trace drive_level (EMA / floor) is functionally analogous but architecturally distinct -- the paper supports the NECESSITY of a sustained signal at contact without endorsing WHERE REE places the trace. It also does not test the seeding threshold concept directly.
mapping.source_context: Mice; optogenetic stimulation/inhibition of arcuate AgRP neurons with calcium imaging and quantified appetitive/consummatory feeding behaviour.

confidence_components.notes: eLife, Knight lab, causal optogenetics with clean behavioural quantification -- very high source quality. Mapping fidelity high because the collapse-at-contact + sustained-trace dynamic is the exact phenomenon MECH-306 was registered to handle (EXQ-536a anchor). Transfer risk the standard rodent-circuit -> REE-scalar gap, plus the trace-site mismatch.
